theorems.name: Submission.rsod_allardHypotheses_small_scale
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ), 1 ≤ n → ∀ (U : Set (Amb n ℓ)), IsOpen U → ∀ (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U) (H : Amb n ℓ → Amb n ℓ) (p : ℝ), (n : ℝ) < p → V.HasGeneralizedMeanCurvature H → V.LocallyLp H p → (∀ᵐ x ∂V.weight, 1 ≤ V.mult x) → (0 : Amb n ℓ) ∈ U → V.HasDensity 0 1 → ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → ∃ ρ : ℝ, V.AllardHypotheses H p δ ρ
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
